body_en: Conflict happens. Stay calm, state facts, suggest a fair fix. Apologize when you hurt someone, even if you did not mean it. Forgive when others change. Holding anger forever costs you more. Peace is also something you build.
body_zh: 冲突总会有。保持冷静，陈述事实，提出公平办法。伤到人就道歉，即使不是故意。对方改了就原谅。永远憋着怒气更伤自己。和平也是建出来的。
